title: From Voiceprints to User Entities: Online Speaker-Memory Construction for Multi-User Spoken Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized spoken agents must identify speakers before accessing user-specific memory, yet memory benchmarks typically assume correctly attributed histories. We argue that voiceprints are observations of identity, not identities themselves, and formulate online speaker-memory construction to maintain persistent user entities as acoustic evidence evolves. We introduce EvoSpeakerMem, a training-free layer for causal speaker routing, selective acoustic-state updates, and identity-partitioned memory writes and retrieval through a replaceable text-memory backend. We also construct LoCoMo-ID, a spoken-memory benchmark with hidden speaker identities, speaker-sensitive queries, simulated recording-condition shifts, and four-speaker identity-confusion tests. translated_title: 从声纹到用户实体：面向多用户语音代理的在线说话人-记忆构建
translated_abstract: 个性化语音代理必须在访问用户专属记忆之前识别说话人，然而现有的记忆基准测试通常假设历史记录已被正确归属。我们提出，声纹是身份的观察结果，而非身份本身，并形式化了在线说话人-记忆构建问题，以在声学证据不断演进的过程中维护持久的用户实体。我们引入了 EvoSpeakerMem，这是一个免训练的层，用于实现因果说话人路由、选择性声学状态更新，以及通过可替换的文本记忆后端进行按身份分区的记忆写入与检索。我们还构建了 LoCoMo-ID，这是一个包含隐藏说话人身份、说话人敏感查询、模拟录音条件变化和四说话人身份混淆测试的语音记忆基准。在纵向数据集 SMIIP-TV 上，在固定的接近注册阈值下，真实探测的拒绝率在约一年内从 29.8% 上升到 55.6%。在 LoCoMo-ID 的说话人敏感查询上（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出 EvoSpeakerMem 免训练框架，将声纹视为对身份的动态观察而非固定标签，通过在线说话人-记忆构建随声学证据演进维护持久的用户实体，并构建了 LoCoMo-ID 基准以评估多用户语音代理中的说话人身份归属与记忆管理问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EvoSpeakerMem, a training-free framework that treats voiceprints as evolving observations of identity rather than fixed labels, maintaining persistent user entities through online speaker-memory construction, and introduces the LoCoMo-ID benchmark to evaluate speaker attribution and memory management in multi-user spoken agents.
